title: Understanding Implied Volatility and the Volatility Surface
description: A focused, practitioner-style walkthrough of implied volatility and how it organizes itself into a surface across strikes and expiries. Built for quant analyst aspirants, prop trading applicants, and systematizing traders who already understand Black-Scholes and want to go one level deeper into how real options desks read volatility. Covers IV vs historical/realized vol, the smile and skew, term structure, and how to assemble and interpret a full volatility surface, using Nifty, Bank Nifty, and India VIX data throughout.
